name: How do I choose the right general contractor for a multi-room renovation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for a multi-room renovation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor in the Bay Area, look for one with a strong portfolio of multi-room interior renovations, positive client testimonials, and a transparent communication style. Verify their licensing and insurance. A good contractor will provide a detailed proposal, clearly outlining the scope, timeline, and costs, and will be knowledgeable about local building codes and permitting processes in your specific city, such as San Bruno or South San Francisco. Don't hesitate to ask for references and visit past project sites.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with a strong portfolio, positive testimonials, proper licensing/insurance, transparent communication, and knowledge of local Bay Area building codes and permitting.
